description: AC-32.1 GS1 AI parser vectors: GS1 Barcode Syntax Engine suite vectors within the BR-32.1 AI table plus 60 Passage edge vectors. Generated by gen_gs1_ai_vectors.py; do not edit by hand.

excluded.reason: bracketed-input syntax with AI 235 (outside the BR-32.1 table); the device parses raw scans, not bracketed text
bracketed-input syntax errors (empty brackets, escapes, '^' in bracketed data); not reachable from a scan
encoder limits (MAX_AIS = 64, output buffer capacity), not GS1 syntax rules
empty raw string without FNC1: framing of the encoder's raw input; a scan always has a symbology identifier or data
unprefixed '991234' is MISSING_FNC1 to the encoder; BR-32.1 deliberately parses an unprefixed element string when the step expects GS1
MAX_AIS encoder limit and permitUnknownAIs mode
AI 89 is not a GS1 AI; the suite admits it only with permitUnknownAIs
AI association rules (GS1 GS 4.13 mandatory and 4.14 invalid pairs, 'req'/'ex'); BR-32.1 parses each label on its own and does not apply them
digital-signature rules for AIs 253, 255, 8003, 8030 (outside the BR-32.1 table)
empty check-digit component cannot occur in a fixed-length AI
empty set-82 component is valid to the linter but an empty AI 10 is a length error
byte 0x1D is GS, the separator of a raw element string
empty numeric component; an empty AI 37 is a length error
10-digit numeric component is longer than AI 37 (N..8), the only BR-32.1 variable numeric AI
